name: scene3d_add_object_keyframes
description: Move non-SOMA scene objects over time: poses at timestamp > 0, interpolated from where each object already stands (t=0 is always its current transform, so do not send it). Rotation is in degrees; autoOrient turns an object along its path. Send every object in ONE call via tracks[]. Max 60 poses per object per take, 24 animated objects per take. SOMA people always use generated actor motion, never object keyframes. @see guides_get('scene3d')

tracks.description: One entry per object you are animating — send them all in this single call. Max 24 animated objects per take.

autoOrient.description: Turn the object to face its direction of travel. Default true for people, false otherwise. Only applied when the track is created.

poses.description: Poses in order. Max 60 per object per take.

easing.description: Easing INTO this pose: smooth, linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out. Default globalEasing.

faceToward.description: {x,y,z} to look at, in world units; derives rotationY. Wins over rotationY.

position.description: {x,y,z} destination in world units. Omit to hold the current position.

rotationY.description: Yaw (deg). Ignored while autoOrient is on.

timestamp.description: Local time (s) in the take, > 0. t=0 is the object where it already stands.

shotId.description: Take to animate in (scene3d_add_shots / scene3d_state). Required once the sequence has more than one.
